claims.text: Live Executor wedge harness on integration/phase2, including the admission-deny scenario that needs the P2.06 fence: {value}
claims.scope_caveat: One run per scenario per revision, each in a disposable namespace; Guard is not under test. The 4139385 admission-deny run is FAILED on one harness check only: it expected the fence to leave metadata.generation unchanged, but a Deployment bumps generation on an annotation change. Its other 11 checks passed (CONFLICT/FENCED, exactly one fence, the workload released, the second proposal APPLIED). The harness check was fixed in 17d4532 to compare the spec, and the rerun at 5409092 passed all 12 checks. Fencing is off by default in the Executor. One Windows/amd64 host with Docker Desktop and kind (cluster kind-sentinel-boutique-connected); containers on one host are not separate machines.
